name: keizai-video
description: 5分でわかる経済ニュース解説動画（Remotion）

scripts.voice:line: python scripts/tts.py --script src/line/lines.json --out public/line/voice --manifest src/line/voice-manifest.json --voice jm_kumo --speed 1.0
scripts.encode:line: ffmpeg -y -i out/denkidai-master.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 27 -pix_fmt yuv420p -af volume=-1.5dB -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart release/denkidai-line.mp4
scripts.encode:route: ffmpeg -y -i out/denkidai-route-master.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 27 -pix_fmt yuv420p -af volume=-1.5dB -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart release/denkidai-route.mp4
scripts.voice:route: python scripts/tts_sbv2.py --script src/route/lines.json --out public/route/voice --manifest src/route/voice-manifest.json --voice jvnv-M1-jp --length 0.9
scripts.encode:talk: ffmpeg -y -i out/denkidai-talk-master.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 27 -pix_fmt yuv420p -af volume=-1.5dB -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart release/denkidai-talk.mp4
scripts.maps:talk: remotion still MapBaseUs public/talk/map-us.jpg --scale=3 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=92 && remotion still MapBasePacific public/talk/map-pacific.jpg --scale=1.5 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=92
